name: Zuki Hirabayashi
source:
Zuki on the outside portrays a cold and calculated personality, but has a soft spot for her best friend, Amimi.  Zuki doesn't take nonsense from anyone, including friends, but will fiercely defend them at all costs. Fighting Game Savant.

[From [url=https://www.tsofgame.com/characters]official website[/url]]
